description: This Java source file defines the class DittoJsonException, a custom runtime exception for handling JSON-related errors within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It wraps JsonRuntimeException instances, adds HTTP status codes, headers, and provides utility methods to catch and rethrow exceptions as DittoJsonException.

classes.name: DittoJsonException
